tests: 11 analysis tests passed, covering multilingual-safe identifier tokenization, noise filtering, TF-IDF vectors, BM25 scoring, route/datastore vocabulary signals, neighborhood enrichment, deterministic label ranking, and unknown-safe behavior

benchmark_outcomes.name: deterministic candidate ordering
benchmark_outcomes.details: Equal scores are ordered by canonical label.

known_limitations: Lexical semantic extraction is intentionally classical and deterministic; it does not infer meaning beyond observed vocabulary.
schema_changes: Added serializable LexicalVector and deterministic lexical feature APIs.
